cases.expectation: No visible item rows still produce one printable blank row and one page with usedUnits=1.
Rows totaling exactly 8 units remain on a single page.
The first row that would make usedUnits exceed 8 starts a new page.
Explicit newlines and long descriptions use estimateDocumentItemRowUnits before page partitioning.
Every page remains at or below the 8-unit budget and row ordering is preserved.
documentPagesHtml marks isFinalPage=false for all but the final chunk and true only for the last chunk.
Delivery/Tax and Receipt produce identical partition signatures for the same item rows.

decision.reason: Keep Step 3B-5 as a behavior-proof checkpoint. A later step can change runtime ownership while this harness detects page-partition regressions independently.

nextCandidate: Step 3B-6 Printable Items + Pagination Extraction behind explicit inputs and pageBudgetUnits, with this harness unchanged as the regression guard.
